stores.description: Aristino is a “Made in Vietnam” fashion brand using natural materials and fits tailored for Vietnamese customers. Its modern, refined designs blend European influences with Vietnamese cultural inspiration.

Chelle Fashion specializes in office wear and casual street styles with a feminine, elegant yet youthful vibe. The brand focuses on quality fabrics and careful tailoring, making outfits easy to match and flattering for many occasions.

Merriman offers premium men’s office fashion inspired by classic British style. Its refined, versatile designs suit both professional and everyday wear, aiming for the image of a modern, successful man.
Pantio follows a minimalist, youthful, modern style while continuously updating trends. The brand supports you in shaping your personal style with positive energy.

Rabity is a Vietnamese children’s fashion brand with a wide retail network. Its products are safe and comfortable, supporting kids’ movement and exploration. The brand also partners with major entertainment licensors for official collaborations.

The Blues offers a wide range of apparel and accessories for adults and children, including clothing, shoes, bags, hats, belts, and more. The spacious store layout provides a comfortable shopping experience.
Dookki is a Korean topokki hotpot buffet chain with a rich menu, comfortable seating, and professional service. It’s a fun self-serve experience, ideal for groups of friends or families.
Kai Sushibar serves sushi, sashimi, and other Japanese dishes in a cozy setting. Fresh ingredients and a varied menu make it suitable for lunch, dates, or casual meetups at an accessible price point.
KFC is a well-known fast-food chain famous for its signature seasoned fried chicken. The menu also includes burgers, chicken rice, fries, and side dishes—quick and convenient for all ages.

MIXUE is known for milk tea and a variety of refreshing drinks with easy-to-enjoy flavors at affordable prices. The brand emphasizes ingredient quality and consistent preparation—great for a quick break while shopping.

Nét Huế serves Hue-style cuisine in a setting inspired by Vietnam’s former imperial capital with signature décor. Ideal for family meals, meetups with friends, or special occasions, offering a strong Central Vietnam flavor experience.

The Pizza Company combines Italian-inspired pizza with Asian-friendly flavors. With tasty crusts, generous toppings, and lots of cheese, its varied menu is perfect for friends, families, or quick meal orders.

CGV is a modern cinema complex offering multiple formats such as IMAX, 4DX, ScreenX, and Dolby Atmos. With comfortable facilities and a wide range of films and services, it’s great for dates, families, or groups of friends.
Funny Kids is an indoor playground for children with ball pits, slides, and active play zones. The colorful, safe environment helps kids build physical skills, reflexes, and imagination through play.

Face Wash Fox is a high-tech face-wash store combining optimized skincare steps with modern technology. The service is quick and convenient, helping cleanse and care for facial skin effectively for a wide range of customers.

MINISO is a Japanese-inspired lifestyle retail store offering home goods, cosmetics, snacks, and more at reasonable prices. The product range is diverse, practical, and often includes collaborations with popular IPs.

MYKINGDOM specializes in educational toys with verified safety standards. It offers thousands of products from well-known brands such as LEGO, suitable for many age groups—great for gifts and nurturing children’s creativity.

Tân Việt Bookstore is part of Tân Việt’s Culture & Education ecosystem, offering a wide selection of books and learning products. It focuses on official distribution and many licensed titles, suitable for students and families.

WinMart is a supermarket offering a wide variety of groceries, personal care products, and household essentials. Conveniently located inside the mall, it supports everyday family needs with a broad product range.

3D Spring produces 4-season mattresses featuring a smart 3D structure that is breathable and easy to clean. Safe materials help reduce allergies and provide long-lasting comfort—ideal for families seeking durable, hygienic bedding.

CO&COM is a retail brand for underwear and socks for the whole family. It prioritizes comfort using natural materials such as cotton, bamboo fiber, and modal—soft, absorbent, and supportive of antibacterial performance.

Flash Box is a Korean-style self photo booth where you can get printed photos instantly. With many props, frames, and stickers, it’s great for creative check-ins with friends or couples while shopping.

K-Style Korean BBQ serves Korean grilled BBQ and hotpot, with table-side grilling. The menu includes a variety of meats, vegetables, and side dishes in a warm atmosphere—perfect for groups, families, and Korean BBQ lovers.

LITIBABY is a Vietnamese children’s fashion brand for kids aged 2–8. It offers varied designs using cotton and lightweight fabrics that are soft and breathable—ideal for school, outings, and daily active wear.
TiniWorld is an indoor play center for children with many physical and creative activities. The safe environment supports play-based learning and gives parents peace of mind when visiting with kids.

Memory is a Korean-style instant photo studio, suitable for ID photos or memorable snapshots. The self-shoot experience is fast and convenient—great for taking aesthetic photos while hanging out at the mall.
